stories.headline: Google stretches AI video to 15 seconds — and cuts the price
stories.summary: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is generally available: native clips up from 10 to 15 seconds, price down 30% to $0.07/sec at 720p.

stories.headline: AI stocks take their worst hit in months
stories.summary: The Nasdaq fell 5.5% Thursday, wiping ~$3 trillion off S&P 500 companies; the sell-off spread across Asia Friday (Nikkei −6%).

stories.headline: Xbox Game Pass adds 2 new cozy games, a day-one release, and more
stories.summary: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School lands day-one, joined by the MySims Cozy Bundle and Firefighting Simulator: Ignite.

stories.headline: 39 games coming to Xbox next week, including Football Manager 27
stories.summary: The Nov 9–13 wave also brings Warhammer Survivors (Nov 10) and John Carpenter's Toxic Commando (Nov 12).

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV begins 12-day Latin America trip weeks after surgery
stories.summary: Three weeks after lung-cancer surgery, the pope heads home to Peru on the longest trip of his pontificate.

stories.headline: Iran sends US a nuclear proposal via Qatar
stories.summary: Tehran's proposal would only be discussed after the US meets its seven demands to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; Trump says he'll decide on resuming military action.

stories.headline: The FAA is finally retiring the floppy disks in air traffic control
stories.summary: Systems dating to the 1980s that still run on floppy disks are being replaced by the new Enterprise Information Display System.
